title: Goop's Many Mobs
description: Changes textures for some of the mobs with new interpretations and designs
body:
Changes minecraft's mobs to be new and refreshing for players who may be bored with how they currently look.

The project will be in development for quite some time, so a vast majority of mobs so far haven't been changed, this resource pack will be changed over time with new textures and mobs as I see fit so don't expect frequent updates as this is a project more so for fun.

This resource pack also replaces the item texture of the spawn egg if the mob relating to it is updated.
